//: Publishing policy for the catalog index. Consumed by scripts/catalog-build.mjs.
//expectedSchemaVersion: The index schema_version the build enforces. Bumping this is a BREAKING format change: do NOT bump it on the `main` catalog (pre-v0.1.8 managers have no fallback and will hard-fail). Introduce v2 on a new default branch instead — see pinta-manager docs/features/v0.1.8/catalog-version-compat.md §2.1.
//oldestSupportedFloorBlind: The oldest manager version we still protect via `latest`. A version is eligible to be an adaptor's `latest` when it has NO minimumRequiredManagerVersion floor, OR its floor <= this value. null (default) = only floor-free versions may be `latest` — the safe posture while pre-v0.1.8 (floor-blind) managers exist, since they install `latest` blindly and ignore floors. Raise this (e.g. "0.1.8") only once the older cohort is retired. See §2.2.
//indexMinimumRequiredManagerVersion: Optional index-level floor written to the top of index.json. Leave null. Setting it forces EVERY v0.1.8+ manager into Layer-2 fallback (self-inflicted), and pre-v0.1.8 ignores it anyway — only set it when the index format is genuinely unreadable by older managers. See §0.4.

manifestFloors.//: Per-manifest compatibility floors, lifted into index.json manifests[].minimumRequiredManagerVersion. Shape: { "<adaptor-id>": { "<version>": "<min-manager-version>" } }. Kept here (not in the manifest YAML) so floors never risk the manager's manifest schema. Example: { "pinta-cc": { "2.0.0": "0.1.8" } }.
